source_note: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律
english_source_note: A Strong Law via the Borel-Cantelli Lemma
callout_id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#1
statement_en: Assume $X_1,\ldots,X_n,\ldots$ are independent and identically distributed random variables, and $E|X_1|<\infty$. Let $S_n=X_1+\cdots+X_n$ and $\mu=E(X_1)$. Then $$\frac{S_n}{n}\xrightarrow{P}{\mu}.$$
prerequisites: independent and identically distributed random variables
callout_body: 假设$X_1,...,X_n,...$是独立同分布的随机变量，并且$E|X_1|<\infty$那么令$S_n = X_1+...+X_n,\mu=E(X_1)$,那么有$$\frac{S_n}{n}\xrightarrow{P}{\mu}$$
